_note: The authoritative game database schema (DDL). Three kinds: reference (rules data, NAMES/TRIBE), state (dynamic per-turn records, cited to the dgroup memory map for traceability only), config (tunable cfg scalars). One path grammar addresses any cell: game.<col>, power<N>.<col>, colony<N>.<col> / colony<N>.stockpile.<good>, unit<N>.<col>, @SECTION[row].col, cfg.<name>. The runtime interprets this schema; no offsets are needed to rebuild.

columns.name: terrain
columns.meaning: terrain id at the unit's tile

columns.name: terraindef
columns.meaning: terrain defense bonus at its tile

columns.name: cost
columns.meaning: bell cost of the next Founding Father

columns.name: price.<good>
columns.meaning: European base price for good 0..15 (seed from @CARGO)

columns.name: war.<a>.<b>
columns.meaning: 1 if powers a,b are at war

columns.name: sol_birth_bonus
columns.meaning: SoL divisor bump on a birth

columns.name: tory_divisor_base
columns.meaning: tory penalty divisor (human: base-diff; ai: base)

columns.name: ref_accrue_gate_years
columns.meaning: accrual rate doubles at each gate year
